expected_level_description: You can: - process a range of transactions, including credit notes, refunds, and journals - reconcile supplier statements, bank accounts, and control accounts - resolve routine queries from suppliers, customers, and budget holders - spot duplicate, unusual, or unauthorised transactions and raise them
You can: - use spreadsheets well, including formulas, lookups, and pivot tables - maintain finance system data, such as cost centres, suppliers, and approvers - report and help fix system problems

You can: - operate key controls, such as separation of duties and supplier bank detail checks - provide evidence to auditors and answer their questions - check that spending is approved at the right level
You can: - explain why cash matters as well as budgets - record and reconcile bank transactions
You can: - recognise sales tax on invoices and code it correctly - explain when to ask a tax specialist for advice
You can: - explain that the organisation spends public money and must account for it - explain the difference between capital and revenue spending

You can: - listen to the needs of design and business stakeholders and interpret information - take part in discussions within a multidisciplinary team - be an advocate for the team externally, and can manage differing perspectives - shape and share communications relevant to the audience
You can: - follow the organisation's rules for handling personal and health information - recognise and report a data breach or near miss
